description: Answer "why are my messages failing / not arriving?": checks the WhatsApp number connection (QR logged out, access removed by Meta, test number, billing block), the reasons Meta gave for the latest failed messages, failed automatic store messages, and automatic messages whose WhatsApp template is not approved, and whether the AI is set to answer only customers from ads (why the AI did not reply) — each problem with its fix. Read-only.
name: diagnose_messaging
